content.text: One decision before I change the export.

questions.question:
The export job writes `orders.csv` nightly. Two readers depend on its column order: the finance import (`finance/import.py`) and the BI dashboard's loader.

The new schema adds `currency` and renames `amount` to `amount_minor`.

- Finance reads **by position**, so a new column in the middle breaks it silently.
- The dashboard reads by header name.
- Both run after midnight, UTC.
- Finance deploys on Thursdays only.
- The dashboard deploys on every merge.

How should I roll out the schema change?

options.label: Append new columns at the end
options.description: Finance keeps working; amount stays until both readers move. Two releases.

options.label: Change both readers in the same PR
options.description: One release, but finance must deploy with it.

options.label: Version the file
options.description: Write orders-v2.csv beside it and move readers one at a time.
